quotes.author: Sara W
quotes.text: Loved this dolphin tour!! What an incredible experience!! Not only did we see multiple dolphin pods but we got to see a few babies as well!! The captain and crew were very knowledgeable and answered all of my husbands questions (and he had many mind you). You could tell they enjoy what they do! Loved this trip and highly recommend to anyone looking for a memorable experience.

quotes.author: Explorer630820
quotes.text: Tons and Tons of dolphins Within 20 minutes we encountered a pod of 50-60 dolphins! Cpt Jamie said it’s unusual to see such a large pod together but not rare. Lots of helpful information about local marine life, fairly calm water and decent weather! Really enjoyed seeing so many dolphins up close. And for such a long time. Worth every penny. Thank you for a great afternoon!

quotes.author: Allie B
quotes.text: Fantastic experience! Fantastic dolphin watching! Took off from the most adorable downtown area on Roanoke, easy to find and free parking. Saw dolphins basically right away! And SO MANY! Our guide was so knowledgeable and fun, it made the trip. We had a really wonderful time and would absolutely recommend going!

quotes.author: OBXVacayFamily
quotes.text: A wonderful dolphin cruise Capt Johnny's Dolphin Tours did a great job! The captain was very friendly and informative. We saw so many dolphins that we lost count! Dolphins from beginning to end!! The boat seating was good and there was a canopy for sun protection if you wanted it.

quotes.author: Maryellen T
quotes.text: Great Experience! Absolutely amazing time!! Captain Jaime was awesome and the dolphins were plentiful!! My friends and I enjoyed the relaxing ,fun day! We got our Snickers!!!

quotes.author: larainecarl1
quotes.text: Subset dolphin cruise Awesome we truly enjoyed the sunset cruise. The captain and his crew were so knowledgeable and professional. Great experience we would book again.
